items.title: StyleSmuggler: Magento and Adobe Commerce 0-day RCE under active attack
items.summary: An unauthenticated remote code execution (RCE) zero-day vulnerability actively exploited in the wild, allowing attackers to run malicious code on online store servers without logging in. Adobe released an emergency hotfix for this critical flaw.

items.title: Stored Cross-site Scripting (XSS) in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: A critical Stored XSS vulnerability with a CVSS base score of 9.3, which does not require authentication and could result in privilege escalation. This was addressed as part of APSB26-138.

items.title: Stored Cross-site Scripting (XSS) in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: Another critical Stored XSS vulnerability with a CVSS base score of 9.3, not requiring authentication and potentially leading to privilege escalation. This was addressed as part of APSB26-138.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: This regularly scheduled update resolves multiple critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities, including issues that could lead to security feature bypass and privilege escalation. Adobe recommends applying these updates promptly.

items.title: Adobe Commerce Auth Bypass Vulnerability
items.summary: An authorization bypass flaw allowing low-privileged authenticated attackers to bypass security features and read select data without user interaction. SentinelOne published an analysis of this vulnerability.

items.title: Unauthenticated Customer Account Takeover in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: A critical unauthenticated customer account takeover vulnerability with a CVSS score of 9.1, allowing attackers to switch a customer session to another account without prior authentication or administrator privileges. This was a key fix in APSB26-92.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: This security update resolves seven vulnerabilities, including five critical issues, that could lead to arbitrary code execution, security feature bypass, and privilege escalation. Adobe rated this update with Priority 2.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: This regularly scheduled security update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities. Successful exploitation could lead to arbitrary code execution, security feature bypass, and privilege escalation.
